evaluator.recency_source: git log --no-merges --name-only -n400 at preimage revision; first-seen unique eligible paths

limitations: One hand-picked post-hoc base case is a diagnostic reality check, not an effect estimate.
The source repository contained future objects; audited tensor arms do not read QueryView.repo, but this was not an externally issued preimage-isolation run.
Gold and retrievers share one process in benchmark.py; no external issuer authenticates gold, isolation, or the caller-asserted recency order.
The query derives from the answer commit and retains symbol/patch leakage after path-token scrubbing.
No Type-plane candidate, Data/Type gold, second-repository transfer, semantic LLM encoder, promotion, or scientific Decision API is present.
VALID means the diagnostic report contract and receipts validated; it does not mean the research claim is validated.
The frozen primary corpus may not be changed or tuned from this measured diagnostic without a new pre-registered packet/case census.

query.leakage_note: Raw commit text names post-change symbols and contains reviewer/coauthor metadata; path-token scrubbing does not remove every symbol or patch echo.

security.audit_note: Counts come from an independent local read-only policy audit; matched secret values were never emitted.

selection.algorithm: sorted preimage blobs in center; expand @tests; apply explicit stricter benchmark overlay; apply frozen s09 Budget.eligible
selection.overlay_policy_note: This blanket benchmark overlay is deliberately stricter than project egress allow_exceptions; it excludes all device files, including nine _base.py/_simulated.py exceptions.
